resources.string: Freeze locks the touchscreen during a call so little hands can carry the phone around without hanging up. Pull down the notification shade any time to unlock.
To lock straight from the pull-down shade, edit your Quick Settings and drag the Freeze tile in.
Home screen widget: long-press your home screen → Widgets → Freeze. Tapping it shows the Freeze notification.
Freeze tile added to Quick Settings
Unlock automatically when the call ends
Emergency unlock: tap the top-right corner 5 times

• During a call: pull down the shade and tap Lock (or the Freeze tile). Swipe the shade back up.

• Unlock: pull down the shade and tap Unlock. It also unlocks by itself about 3 seconds after the call ends.

• Turn off Settings → Accessibility → "Power button ends call" if your phone has it. No app can block the power button.

• Home and back gestures still work while locked. They don't end calls, and the lock stays on top.

• If "Display over other apps" is greyed out, open App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, then try again.

• Restarting the phone always clears the lock.
